ओटीटी पर छाया मनोज बाजपेयी का जलवा, फिल्म ने मचाया तूफान। 🍿
निर्देशक रितेश शाह और निर्माता नीरज पांडे की क्राइम थ्रिलर फिल्म Gajab Raat ने Netflix पर धमाकेदार एंट्री ली है। 🎬
19 अक्टूबर 2026 से 25 अक्टूबर 2026 के Netflix डेटा के मुताबिक, फिल्म ने पहले हफ्ते में 4.2 मिलियन व्यूज और 8.8 मिलियन viewing hours हासिल किए। 📊
यह फिल्म 17 देशों में टॉप 10 में शामिल हुई और भारत, यूएई, मॉरीशस, बांग्लादेश, कतर और बहरीन समेत 9 देशों में नंबर 1 पर रही। 🌍
Netflix की ग्लोबल ट्रेंडिंग नॉन-इंग्लिश फिल्मों की लिस्ट में इसने दूसरा स्थान हासिल किया है। 🏆
इसने 2024 से 2026 के बीच रिलीज हुई डायरेक्ट-टू-डिजिटल हिंदी Netflix Original फिल्मों में टॉप 10 डेब्यू हफ्ता प्रदर्शन में जगह बनाई और Made In Korea, Dhoom Dhaam और Nadaaniyan को पीछे छोड़ दिया। 🔥

ctx.title: Gajab Raat OTT Verdict: Manoj Bajpayee Debuts With A Roaring Viewership – Breaks 3 Opening Records On Netflix!
ctx.summary:
Manoj Bajpayee has broken three massive viewership records on Netflix with Gajab Raat's arrival on the platform - OTT Verdict. 
 The post  Gajab Raat OTT Verdict: Manoj Bajpayee Debuts With A Roaring Viewership – Breaks 3 Opening Records On Netflix!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Manoj Bajpayee has delivered an absolute viewership storm on global streaming! Overcoming pre-release hurdles and a high-profile title change, director Ritesh Shah and producer Neeraj Pandey’s edge-of-the-seat crime thriller Gajab Raat has made an explosive debut on Netflix. The Delhi-set thriller featured in the Top 10 in 17 countries while claiming the #1 rank in 9 nations, including India, UAE, Mauritius, Bangladesh, Qatar, and Bahrain!
As per data from Netflix from October 19, 2026 to October 25, 2026, Gajab Raat, in its debut week, garnered a viewership of 4.2 million on Netflix, with 8.8 million viewing hours, and secured the second spot in the globally trending list of top 10 non-English films on Netflix.
By registering 4.2 million views in week 1, Gajab Raat has officially shattered 3 massive opening viewership records on the streaming platform!
Gajab Raat has officially earned a spot among the top 10 debut week performances for direct-to-digital Hindi Netflix Original films released between 2024 and 2026, outpacing Made In Korea, Dhoom Dhaam, and Nadaaniyan.
Here are the top 10 debut-week viewership figures for Netflix Original films that arrived on the platform from 2024 to 2026.
Focusing strictly on direct-to-digital films released in 2026, Manoj Bajpayee’s gritty performance has made the film straight into the Top 5 biggest opening debuts of the year.
Here are the top 5 debut-week viewership numbers for Netflix Original films that arrived on the platform in 2026.
When evaluated against all Indian films premiering on Netflix in 2026, including post-theatrical blockbuster releases, Gajab Raat comfortably secures a position among the Top 10 highest-viewed Indian titles of the year in their debut weeks.
Here are the top 10 debut-week viewership numbers for Indian films that arrived on the platform in 2026. These films arrived on the platform either after a theatrical release or directly.
Note: The debut week viewership numbers are the official numbers given by Netflix for all the films that arrived on the platform, irrespective of the day they arrived in a week. Some arrived on the fourth day of the week, some on the 5th, and so on, but the debut numbers are calculated by Netflix weekly, not day-wise.
